_comment: Hand-authored from flrig RIG_FT891 (src/rigs/yaesu/FT891.cxx). Commands end with ';'. {f9} = 9-digit zero-padded frequency, {n3} = 3-digit zero-padded integer, {n2} = 2-digit.

bandwidth._comment: flrig set_bwA: NA0{0|1} selects the narrow filter when the table index is at or below narrowMaxIndex, then SH0 sets the width index (wvals).

notes: flrig also writes EX menu items (EX1107/EX0707/EX1011/EX0812) to track sideband for CW/RTTY/DATA; v1 relies on MD0 codes 8 (DATA-L) and C (DATA-U) directly.
Radio must be set to CAT RATE 38400 (menu 05-06) and CAT RTS enabled to match flrig settings.
